text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oof... The sun is so bright. It's making<n>me dizzy.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just that there's a child<n>staying at my
parents' place right<n>now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They keep waking up in the middle of<n>the night and
won't go to sleep until<n>they talk to me for some
reason.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm getting multiple phone calls every<n>night...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mnnh... I feel like I might pass out on<n>the spot...
